responsibility: Collection of target-dependent runtime symbols and utility routines used by GNAT low-level libraries. It supplies host-specific text/binary mode switching, file and task option helpers, VxWorks and Linux capability queries, filesystem error classification, Android wrappers for inline signal-set functions, and other OS-specific constants or behaviors that do not fit the broader imported-service catalog in adaint.c. Its role is to gather miscellaneous runtime dependencies on platform semantics.
